news.title: Trump pushes to admit 17,500 White Afrikaners from South Africa in 2027 refugee cap
news.summary: The Trump administration on Wednesday proposed raising the refugee cap for the coming year to 17,500 people, which is a historically low figure, and which President Trump argued should primarily be given to white Afrikaners. The move raises by 10,000 last year’s refugee cap – the lowest proposed rate in the history of the program…
